(TBD depending on information as it comes, but:)
His family came during one of the early settlements to Empire City. His brothers and father worked on the railroads while he started as a newsie from 7 years old. His passion for investigative journalism got him into some scraps, but he was able to make an honest business announcing the going abouts in the city. His regular broadcasts and news articles are sure to be seen circulating, and he plans on using it to keep all informed.

Previously submitted and might change, but the concept is that Finn grew up in this city with a blue collar family. He worked selling newspapers as a newsie on a street corner as a child, but later became an opinion leader and announcer for radio broadcast in the town. He operates an independent news station and paper that works to investigate crime, announce on the city's going ons, and sharing whatever truths he finds or conjures up.
